llms.body:
# Elgato

> Elgato designs premium hardware and software for content creators — Stream Deck, Wave microphones, Key Light, Facecam, and more. This file lists product-level documentation and Explorer guides written for AI agents.

## Audio

- [Wave DX](/m/wave-dx-dynamic-microphone.md): A dynamic XLR microphone that captures detail like a condenser without the noise — broadcast-quality vocal sound with no inline booster required.
- [Wave Go](/m/wave-go.md): Convertible wireless microphone that works clip-on or handheld, plugging into your phone or computer via USB-C for broadcast-quality audio wherever you film.
- [Wave Mic Arm](/m/wave-mic-arm.md): A studio-grade suspension boom arm for premium microphones, offering 360-degree adjustability, integrated cable channels, a counterweight system, and broad mic mount compatibility for streamers and podcasters.
- [Wave Mic Arm LP](/m/wave-mic-arm-lp.md): A studio-grade low-profile boom arm for your professional microphone — sits below the shoulder line for an unobstructed view.
- [Wave Mic Arm MK.2](/m/wave-mic-arm-mk2.md): An upgraded studio boom arm with a longer all-metal construction, greater reach, improved flexibility, and snap-on hinge cap customization for creators who demand the most versatile and refined mic arm available.
- [Wave Mic Arm Pro](/m/wave-mic-arm-pro-black.md): Gas-piston boom arm with internal cable management and integrated Wave XLR mount for professional, clutter-free microphone setups.
- [Wave Neo](/m/wave-neo.md): Affordable plug-and-play USB condenser microphone standing at the right height, with clear audio quality and tap-to-mute control.
- [Wave XLR MK.2](/m/wave-xlr.md): Professional XLR microphone interface with Wave FX Processor, onboard DSP, Clipguard 2.0, and VST Insert support — delivering studio-grade sound and complete audio control in one compact device.
- [Wave XLR Pro](/m/wave-xlr-pro.md): Professional dual-XLR audio matrix interface supporting 5 simultaneous mixes for podcasters, co-hosts, and advanced content creators.
- [Wave:3 MK.2](/m/wave-3.md): Premium USB condenser microphone with Wave FX Processor, Clipguard 2.0, Auto Gain, and VST Insert support — delivering broadcast-quality sound with plug-and-play simplicity.
- [XLR Dock MK.2](/m/xlr-dock-stream-deck-plus.md): A professional audio interface that attaches to Stream Deck + to add an XLR microphone input with Wave FX Processor, 24-bit/48kHz recording, Clipguard 2.0, and VST insert support.

## Camera

- [Cam Link 4K](/m/cam-link-4k.md): A compact capture device that turns your DSLR, mirrorless, or camcorder into a high-quality webcam for creators, streamers, and professionals.
- [Cam Link Pro](/m/cam-link-pro.md): A professional-grade four-channel HDMI video capture card and mixer that allows streamers, educators, and video professionals to capture and mix up to four simultaneous HDMI sources at 4K or 1080p with independent stream control.
- [Conferencing Kit +](/m/conferencing-kit-plus.md): A premium all-in-one video conferencing kit combining Elgato Prompter, Facecam MK.2, and Wave Desk Stand with Airtime Camera and Airtime Suite subscriptions.
- [Facecam](/m/facecam-mk2.md): Webcam with smooth HDR video up to 1080p60 resolution, Sony sensor, and manual DSLR-style controls for professional streaming and content creation.
- [Facecam 4K](/m/facecam-4k.md): Professional USB webcam with true 4K60fps, Sony STARVIS 2 sensor, and interchangeable magnetic lens filters for creators who demand cinema-quality face camera video.
- [Facecam Neo](/m/facecam-neo.md): Easy-to-set-up 1080p60 webcam with smooth video, HDR support, autofocus, and a built-in privacy shutter — Zoom certified and ready right out of the box.
- [Facecam Pro](/m/facecam-pro.md): A discontinued ultra-premium 4K 60fps webcam built around a 1/1.8-inch Sony STARVIS sensor and a custom Elgato autofocus lens, designed for streamers and creators who demand broadcast-quality video from a desktop camera.
- [Prompter](/m/prompter.md): All-in-one teleprompter with a built-in 9-inch display and Voice Sync scrolling for creators who need to deliver scripts while maintaining natural eye contact with the camera.
- [Prompter XL](/m/prompter-xl.md): A professional studio teleprompter with a 15.6-inch 1080p 600-nit removable display, 15-foot reading range, and USB-C single-cable setup for production teams and creators.

## Capture

- [4K Pro](/m/game-capture-4k-pro.md): A PCIe internal capture card for desktop PCs offering 8K60 HDMI 2.1 passthrough and 4K60 HDR10 capture at up to 240fps, designed for hardcore PC gamers and dual-PC streaming setups.
- [4K S](/m/game-capture-4k-s.md): A portable USB-C capture card delivering 4K60 HDR10 or up to 1080p240 high frame rate capture with zero-latency passthrough, optimized for PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch 2.
- [4K X](/m/game-capture-4k-x.md): A USB game capture card with high resolution for gaming, streaming, and recording.
- [Chat Link Pro](/m/chat-link-pro.md): A premium audio capture cable that captures both gameplay and voice chat audio from PS5, PS4, or Nintendo Switch controller headset jacks and routes it to a PC capture card or line-in port for recording and streaming.
- [Game Capture Neo](/m/game-capture-neo.md): An entry-level USB-C capture card that simultaneously passes through gameplay to a screen and captures it to any app, designed for first-time console creators who want a simple, jargon-free setup.
- [Game Capture Neo](/m/game-capture-neo-black.md): An entry-level USB-C capture card that simultaneously passes through gameplay to a screen and captures it to any app, designed for first-time console creators who want a simple, jargon-free setup. (1)
- [HD60 X](/m/game-capture-hd60-x.md): External USB capture card supporting 4K30 or 1080p60 HDR10 pass-through capture from consoles, cameras, and HDMI sources.
- [Video Capture](/m/video-capture.md): A USB capture device and software bundle that digitizes analogue video from VCRs, DVRs, camcorders, and other composite or S-Video sources into high-quality H.264 files on Mac or PC.

## Green Screen

- [Green Screen](/m/green-screen.md): A portable pop-up chroma key panel with a pneumatic x-frame that deploys in seconds, giving streamers a wrinkle-resistant green surface for virtual background replacement without a permanent studio setup.
- [Green Screen Mouse Mat](/m/green-screen-mouse-mat.md): An XL chroma key desk pad measuring 940×400mm that transforms your entire desktop surface into a green screen background for overhead camera shots, hand cams, and creative keying effects in streaming and video production.
- [Green Screen MT](/m/green-screen-mt.md): A wall- or ceiling-mountable chroma key panel with a precision roller mechanism that covers 200 × 180 cm and retracts with a single tug, offering full-body coverage without occupying any floor space.
- [Green Screen XL](/m/green-screen-xl.md): Extra-wide collapsible chroma key panel with wrinkle-resistant material for full-body virtual backgrounds, streaming, and video production.

## Lighting

- [Key Light](/m/key-light.md): A professional-grade LED lighting solution for streamers, creators, and remote workers — 2800 lumens with Wi-Fi control and CRI >92.
- [Key Light Air MK.2](/m/key-light-air.md): A compact, creator-grade LED lighting solution for streamers, creators, and remote workers — up to 2100 lumens with USB-C power, touch controls, and app or Stream Deck integration.
- [Key Light Mini](/m/key-light-mini.md): A portable, battery-powered LED key light with Wi-Fi control, 800 lumens output, and a 2900–7000K color range, designed for creators who need professional lighting anywhere without a power outlet.
- [Key Light Neo](/m/key-light-neo.md): Compact, ultra-portable USB-powered LED panel light for professional lighting in small or temporary setups.
- [Light Strip](/m/light-strip-old.md): A Wi-Fi-controlled RGBWW LED strip with 16 million colors and warm-to-cold white light for ambient, bias, and accent lighting in gaming and streaming setups, extendable up to 10 m.
- [Light Strip Pro](/m/light-strip-pro.md): 120 individually addressable RGB LED strip for dynamic gradient bias lighting and on-camera background ambiance in content creator setups.
- [Ring Light](/m/ring-light.md): A 17-inch professional circular LED light using edge-lit architecture to deliver soft, flattering, shadow-free facial illumination with up to 2500 lumens and app control, designed for close-up creators and streamers.

## Multi Mount

- [Cold Shoe](/m/cold-shoe.md): A premium multi-thread mounting adapter for the Elgato Multi Mount system that attaches cameras, microphones, lights, and other audiovisual accessories to camera bodies, Multi Mount rigs, tripods, and any 1/4-inch thread surface.
- [Flex Arm L](/m/flex-arm-l.md): A modular four-pole extension arm with connecting ball joints for Elgato's Multi Mount Modular Rigging System, giving creators 3D adjustability and extended reach.
- [Heavy Base](/m/heavy-base.md): A weighted steel disc base for the Elgato Multi Mount Modular Rigging System that screws onto Master Mount to create a stable, freestanding camera and lighting rig without clamping to a desk or mounting to a wall.
- [Heavy Clamp](/m/heavy-clamp.md): A heavy-duty G-clamp with a ball head and four 1/4-inch threads that attaches to desks, shelves, poles, and irregular objects to mount cameras, lights, and microphones in virtually any environment.
- [Master Mount L](/m/master-mount-l.md): A height-adjustable desk clamp mounting pole serving as the core anchor for the Elgato Multi Mount modular rig system, supporting cameras, lights, and accessories from 55 cm to 125 cm high.
- [Mini Mount](/m/mini-mount.md): A compact, adjustable desktop rig for cameras, lights, microphones, and tablets, offering height-adjustable positioning and a 360-degree ball head in a minimal footprint for creators with small or shared workspaces.
- [Phone Grip](/m/phone-grip.md): A spring-loaded smartphone clamp for the Elgato Multi Mount Modular Rigging System that secures phones at any height, angle, and orientation on a desktop rig.
- [Solid Arm](/m/solid-arm.md): A steel horizontal extension pole that clamps onto a Master Mount or other Multi Mount component to add an auxiliary 1/4-inch mounting point for cameras, lights, or any compatible device.
- [Wall Mount](/m/wall-mount.md): A permanent yet adjustable wall-mounted rigging solution with a pole, ball joint, and 1/4-inch ball head screw that anchors Elgato Multi Mount accessories — cameras, lights, and more — directly to walls for cable-free desk space.

## Stream Deck

- [CORSAIR GALLEON 100 SD](/m/galleon-100-sd-stream-deck-integrated-mechanical-keyboard-ch-912a31i-na.md): A CORSAIR-Elgato collaboration that integrates Stream Deck directly into a high-performance mechanical keyboard, giving gamers and creators instant one-press control of games, apps, and workflows without any extra hardware.
- [Network Dock](/m/network-dock-stream-deck.md): A networking accessory that frees Stream Deck from USB by adding Power over Ethernet (PoE) and wired Ethernet connectivity, allowing creators and professionals to deploy Stream Deck anywhere on a network without a nearby PC.
- [Stream Deck](/m/stream-deck.md): A customizable control interface for streamers, creators, and professionals.
- [Stream Deck +](/m/stream-deck-plus.md): A customizable controller for podcasters, broadcasting, streaming, and content creation — combining LCD keys with analog dials and a touch strip.
- [Stream Deck + XL](/m/stream-deck-plus-xl.md): Customizable control surface combining 36 LCD keys, 6 analog dials, and a full-width touch strip for the most expressive creator workflow.
- [Stream Deck Mini](/m/stream-deck-mini.md): A compact 6-key customizable LCD control pad that brings the full Stream Deck experience to tight setups and focused workflows at an accessible entry price.
- [Stream Deck Module (15 Keys)](/m/stream-deck-module-15-keys.md): A 15-key unbranded integration-ready LCD control module for makers and OEMs building custom dashboards, standalone devices, and professional control systems that leverage the full Stream Deck ecosystem.
- [Stream Deck Module (15 Scissor Keys)](/m/stream-deck-module-15-scissor-keys.md): A 15-key unbranded integration-ready LCD control module for makers and OEMs building custom dashboards, standalone devices, and professional control systems that leverage the full Stream Deck ecosystem. 
- [Stream Deck Module (32 Keys)](/m/stream-deck-module-32-keys.md): A 32-key unbranded integration-ready LCD control module built for makers and OEMs who need maximum control density for complex professional applications, multi-layered interfaces, and large-scale control systems.
- [Stream Deck Module (6 Keys)](/m/stream-deck-module-6-keys.md): An unbranded, integration-ready 6-key LCD control module designed for makers, entrepreneurs, and OEMs who want to embed Stream Deck technology into custom hardware products and control systems.
- [Stream Deck Neo](/m/stream-deck-neo.md): Customizable controller for home office, meetings, creators, and professionals — the most accessible entry into the Stream Deck ecosystem.
- [Stream Deck Pedal](/m/stream-deck-pedal.md): Hands-free 3-pedal macro controller that lets creators trigger actions with their feet, keeping both hands free for their work.
- [Stream Deck Scissor Keys](/m/stream-deck-scissor-keys.md): A 15-key control pad featuring premium scissor switches and patented LCD key technology for streamers, creators, and productivity professionals who want tactile, responsive, one-press automation.
- [Stream Deck Studio](/m/stream-deck-studio.md): A professional 32-key broadcast control surface powered by Bitfocus Buttons software with NMOS IS-04/IS-05, PoE+, and NFC authentication, designed for live production teams managing complex signal routing.
- [Stream Deck XL](/m/stream-deck-xl.md): Professional 32-key macro controller with customizable LCD keys for streamers, creators, and power users.

## Guides

### Blog

- [Automatic vs Manual Mic Gain: Which Should You Use?](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/wave/automatic-gain-vs-manual-gain/): Learn how automatic gain control (AGC) and manual microphone gain work, when to use each, and how to avoid noise and clipping.
- [Best Stream Deck Plugins for Productivity](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/stream-deck/best-stream-deck-plugins-for-productivity/): Discover the best Stream Deck plugins for work, from PowerPoint and Slack to timers, audio switching, and more.
- [Best Streaming Software for Twitch, YouTube and TikTok](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/news/streaming/what-streaming-software-is-right-for-you/): See how OBS, Streamlabs, XSplit, vMix, and Meld Studio compare and decide which streaming software fits the way you create.
- [Better Image, More Control: What's New in Facecam 4K Firmware 2.49](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/camera/whats-new-in-facecam-4k-firmware-249/): New tint control, cleaner noise, better color, and sharper detail for Facecam 4K. Here's everything in firmware 2.49.
- [Build faster in Cursor with Stream Deck](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/stream-deck/build-faster-in-cursor-with-stream-deck/): See how Stream Deck can speed up Cursor with one-tap shortcuts and live request tracking from two Marketplace options.
- [Capture Card Acronyms: What They Mean and Why They Matter](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/capture/capture-card-acronyms-what-they-mean-and-why-they-matter/): Learn what capture card acronyms like HDMI, UVC, HDR, and HEVC actually mean and which ones matter for your setup.
- [Chat Link Pro: Capture Party or Lobby Chat While You Play](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/capture/chat-link-pro-capture-party-lobby-chat/): Missing party or lobby chat in your recordings? Chat Link Pro captures voice and game audio from PS5, Xbox, and Switch in one cable.
- [Choosing a Microphone for AI Dictation in ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/wave/choosing-a-microphone-for-ai-dictation/): Your mic affects how well ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini understand you. Learn which mic and setup give you clearer, more accurate AI dictation.
- [Clip-On vs Handheld Mic: Which Should You Use?](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/wave/clip-on-vs-handheld-mic/): Clip-on and handheld mics each suit different shoots. See when to use each, and how Elgato Wave Go covers both with one convertible mic system.
- [Control Claude with Stream Deck for faster workflows](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/stream-deck/control-claude-with-stream-deck-for-faster-workflows/): Learn how to use Stream Deck plugins and profiles to streamline your Claude workflow and keep track of your usage.
- [Control OBS Studio from Stream Deck](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/marketplace/streamline-your-production-with-the-obs-studio-plugin-for-stream-deck/): Control OBS Studio scenes, audio, and recordings from Stream Deck. Free plugin for macOS and Windows.
- [Deck your Stream Deck with a Reindeer Tamagotchi and Holiday Icons](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/marketplace/deck-your-stream-deck-with-a-reindeer-tamagotchi-and-holiday-icons/): Deck your Stream Deck out for the holidays with a Reindeer Tamagotchi profile, holiday-themed icons, and festive screensavers.
- [Do You Need a Capture Card to Stream or Record?](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/capture/do-you-need-a-capture-card-to-stream/): Streaming from a console or PC? Learn when a capture card matters, when it doesn't, and what to look for if you need one.
- [Elgato Brings Fallout Nuka-Cola™ Style to the Wasteland](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/news/exclusives/elgato-brings-fallout-nuka-cola-style-to-the-wasteland/): Elgato debuts Nuka-Cola™ themed gear inspired by Fallout™, with peripherals from CORSAIR and Drop to complete the collection. Upgrade your setup with a refreshing vault-ready look.
- [Elgato Creator Gift Guide](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/news/exclusives/creator-gift-guide/): Find the perfect gift for the content creator in your life. From premium webcams to Stream Deck control, discover Elgato gear that levels up any creator's setup this holiday season.
- [Elgato Facecam MK.2: Rethink What a Webcam Can Do](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/camera/facecam-mk2-rethink-what-a-webcam-can-do/): Learn what Elgato Facecam MK.2 is, how its uncompressed Full HD video and DSLR-style controls work, and why it's a practical upgrade from a built-in laptop webcam.
- [Elgato Joins the Fight in Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/news/custom-drops/call-of-duty-black-ops-7/): Suit up for Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 with Elgato. Explore limited gear from Elgato, SCUF Gaming, CORSAIR, and ORIGIN PC, and unlock bonus in-game items for your next mission.
- [Elgato Prompter XL — Full-Sized Teleprompter for DSLRs and Studio Cameras](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/teleprompter/full-sized-teleprompter-for-dslrs-and-studio-cameras/): Prompter XL is a full-sized studio teleprompter with a 15.6-inch Full HD display, single-cable setup, and reinforced design. Built for creators and professionals who want sharper visuals and smoother production.
- [Elgato Prompter: Pro Teleprompting Made Easy](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/teleprompter/prompter-pro-teleprompting-made-easy/): Learn what Elgato Prompter is, how its built-in display works, and how it makes pro teleprompting accessible for streamers, creators, and professionals.
- [Elgato Studio — Max Framerate](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/capture/elgato-studio-max-framerate/): Learn what the max framerate setting does in Elgato Studio and how to choose between 30, 60, 120, and 144 fps for your recordings.
- [Elgato Studio — Max Resolution](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/capture/elgato-studio-max-resolution/): Learn what the max resolution setting does in Elgato Studio and how to choose between 4K, 1440p, 1080p, and 720p for your recordings.
- [Elgato Studio — Recording Format](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/capture/elgato-studio-recording-format/): Learn which recording format to use in Elgato Studio. Compare H.264, HEVC, and AV1 for compatibility, file size, and HDR support.
- [Elgato Studio — Recording HDR](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/capture/elgato-studio-hdr/): Learn what HDR recording does in Elgato Studio and how it preserves richer colors, brighter highlights, and more detail in your recordings.
- [Elgato Studio — Recording Quality](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/capture/elgato-studio-recording-quality/): Learn what the recording quality setting does in Elgato Studio and how it affects file size, detail, and storage for your recordings.
- [Elgato Studio — Tone Mapping](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/capture/elgato-studio-tone-mapping/): Learn what the tone mapping toggle does in Elgato Studio and how it helps third-party apps display HDR sources.
- [Elgato Studio 2.0 — The Prompter Experience, Rebuilt](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/teleprompter/elgato-studio-2-0-the-prompter-experience-rebuilt/): Elgato Studio 2.0 rebuilds the Prompter experience with a new script editor, Voice Sync 2.0, and full device controls. Try the beta now.
- [Elgato Studio 2.0: A New Home for Prompter, Cameras, and Capture](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/teleprompter/elgato-studio-2-0-prompter-cameras-capture/): Run Prompter, Facecam, and capture from one free app. Elgato Studio 2.0 adds a new script editor, Voice Sync 2.0, and Virtual Prompter.
- [Elgato Voice Focus — AI Noise Removal for Any Microphone](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/marketplace/voice-focus-make-any-microphone-sound-studio-ready/): Elgato Voice Focus uses AI to remove background noise from any microphone for clear, studio-quality sound while streaming, recording, or on calls.
- [Elgato Wave Go — Broadcast-Quality Wireless Microphone with Clip-On and Handheld Modes](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/wave/wave-go-broadcast-quality-wireless-microphone/): Elgato Wave Go is our first wireless mic, converting between clip-on and handheld with automatic sound processing and up to 48 hours of battery life.
- [Facecam 4K now available in three new colors](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/camera/facecam-4k-now-available-in-three-new-colors/): Facecam 4K adds Carbon, Pine, and White color options, alongside a new CPL Lens Filter.
- [From Spawn to Extract: How Stream Deck can enhance your Tarkov experience](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/stream-deck/stream-deck-escape-from-tarkov/): Discover Stream Deck plugins, profiles, and overlays designed for Escape from Tarkov. Get faster access to actions and custom icons for smoother raids.
- [GALLEON 100 SD: A Mechanical Keyboard with Built-In Stream Deck](https://www.elgato.com/us/en/explorer/products/stream-deck/galleon-100-sd-built-in-stream-deck/): Learn how GALLEON 100 SD improves gaming and everyday workflows by building Stream Deck keys, dials, and a display directly into the keyboard.

# Wave Go - Convertible wireless microphone that works clip-on or handheld, plugging into your phone or computer via USB-C for broadcast-quality audio wherever you film.

## Overview

Wave Go - Convertible wireless microphone that works clip-on or handheld, plugging into your phone or computer via USB-C for broadcast-quality audio wherever you film.

## Key Features

- Convertible design: clip-on transmitter or handheld mic with the Smart Handle
- USB-C receiver for phones and computers (Lightning not supported)
- Onboard sound processing: EQ Shift for each mode, Auto Gain, and switchable noise cancellation
- Always-on low-cut filter and dynamic range control
- 6 mm omnidirectional electret condenser capsule, 24-bit/48 kHz
- Dedicated 2.4 GHz wireless link with up to 24 ms latency and about 30 m (100 ft) range
- About 8 hours per charge, up to 48 hours total with the Smart Handle; 10-minute quick charge for 1 hour of use
- 7 g transmitter with magnetic clip and magnetic plate mounts
- Charge-through port on the receiver (5 W) to power your phone while recording
- Single-button control: power, mute, and double-press to start recording on a connected phone
- Optional Wave Go app for gain, noise cancellation levels, and battery monitoring, free on iOS and Android
- Works with Wave Link and Voice Focus as a desk mic
- Optional second transmitter pairs with the same receiver
- Not designed for direct connection to DSLR or mirrorless cameras; no onboard recording

## Benefits

- Two mics in one, so you never have to carry extra gear
- Rich, broadcast-ready sound whether the mic is on your chest or at your mouth
- No settings to check or levels to dial in: power on and record
- Pack it Monday and you won't need an outlet until Sunday
- Featherlight transmitter that practically disappears on camera
- Doubles as a desk mic that sounds far better than AirPods or laptop audio

## Ideal For

- Creators who film with their phone
- Vloggers and short-form video creators
- Street interviewers and journalists
- Mobile live streamers
- Podcasters
- Remote workers and online teachers

## Example Use Cases

- Story times and talking-to-camera clips
- Street interviews with the Smart Handle
- Hour-long live streams from a phone
- Solo podcasts, or two-person episodes with a second transmitter
- Video calls with clearer audio than built-in mics
- Voice-to-text dictation and speaking prompts out loud
- Online teaching without leaning into the laptop
- Streaming while moving around the room

## Related Products

- Wave Go Transmitter
- Wave Neo
- Wave:3
- Key Light Mini

## Use Case

- Hands-free recording with the clip-on transmitter
- Handheld interviews with the Smart Handle
- Recording straight to a phone via the USB-C receiver
- Toggling noise cancellation with the receiver button
- Fine-tuning gain and noise cancellation in the Wave Go app
- Desk calls and podcasts with Wave Link and Voice Focus
- Two-person recording with a second transmitter

## Problem

- User's phone mic sounds thin or distant when filming on the move.
- User needs both a clip-on and a handheld mic but doesn't want to carry two systems.
- User doesn't want to set levels or settings before every recording.
- User's mic battery runs out mid-shoot or on a trip.
- User wants better desk audio than AirPods or a laptop mic without a bulky setup.

## Recommended Setup

- Wave Go Transmitter for two-person recording
- Wave Link with Voice Focus for desk use

## Why Elgato?

- Two modes in one system, with an EQ profile tuned for each
- Onboard sound engineer: Auto Gain, noise cancellation, low-cut filter, and dynamic range control
- Up to 48 hours of runtime, with the Smart Handle charging the transmitter whenever it's docked
- Dedicated 2.4 GHz connection instead of Bluetooth for better sound, lower latency, and longer battery life
- Part of the Wave ecosystem, with Wave Link and Voice Focus at your desk

## Key Features

- 4K60 capture with HDR10 support
- Up to 1080p240 high frame rate capture with VRR support
- 4K60 HDR10 HDMI 2.0 passthrough with ALLM support
- USB-C 3.2 Gen1 5 Gbps connection, UVC plug-and-play
- 3.5 mm analog line-in for Chat Link Pro
- Works with Windows, Mac, and iPad
- Compatible with OBS, Elgato Studio, TikTok Live Studio, Discord, and more
- Officially designated Best for Nintendo Switch 2

## Benefits

- Captures high frame rate console gameplay without compromising the gaming experience
- Works with laptops and iPads — no desktop PC needed
- Enables simultaneous streaming and high-fidelity local recording
- Captures game audio alongside console chat via the 3.5 mm line-in

## Ideal For

- Console gamers on PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch 2
- Mobile and handheld gamers (iPhone, iPad)
- On-the-go creators who need portability
- Mid-tier streamers who want 4K quality without a PCIe card

## Example Use Cases

- Recording Nintendo Switch 2 gameplay in 4K60 and streaming it live on Twitch
- Capturing PS5 gameplay at 1080p120 for high frame rate YouTube content
- Streaming from a laptop at a gaming event
- Recording clips to edit highlights for TikTok or YouTube Shorts

## Related Products

- Chat Link Pro (included free)
- Elgato Studio software
- Stream Deck Mini or Stream Deck
- Wave Neo microphone
- Facecam or Facecam Neo

## Use Case

- Deliver professional 4K capture quality in a portable, laptop-friendly form factor
- Support the latest consoles including Nintendo Switch 2 at maximum output
- Enable simultaneous streaming and recording without performance compromise

## Problem

- Previous capture cards couldn't keep up with next-gen console resolutions and frame rates
- Desktop-only PCIe cards excluded laptop and iPad users
- Separate audio capture devices needed for chat audio

## Recommended Setup

- Enable HDR10 capture on Windows for the most accurate color representation of PS5 or Xbox HDR output
- Use the 3.5 mm line-in with Chat Link Pro to capture console chat audio in a separate track
- Pair with OBS and enable Play Through Preview mode for near-zero latency gaming while streaming

## Why Elgato?

- One of the only portable capture cards supporting 4K60 HDR10 passthrough and VRR/ALLM via HDMI 2.0
- Works across Windows, Mac, and iPad without drivers — true UVC plug and play
- Officially designated Best for Nintendo Switch 2 for unmatched compatibility with the latest Nintendo hardware

# 4K Pro - A PCIe internal capture card for desktop PCs offering 8K60 HDMI 2.1 passthrough and 4K60 HDR10 capture at up to 240fps, designed for hardcore PC gamers and dual-PC streaming setups.

## Overview

4K Pro - A PCIe internal capture card for desktop PCs offering 8K60 HDMI 2.1 passthrough and 4K60 HDR10 capture at up to 240fps, designed for hardcore PC gamers and dual-PC streaming setups.

## Key Features

- 8K60 HDMI 2.1 passthrough with HDR10, VRR, and ALLM support
- 4K60 HDR10 capture at up to 240fps in 1080p
- PCIe 2.0 x4 interface for maximum bandwidth
- On-device HDR-to-SDR tonemapping
- 3.5 mm analog line-in for Chat Link Pro (included free)
- Flashback Recording to capture gameplay retroactively
- Includes 8K HDMI cable (200 cm)

## Benefits

- Enables 8K passthrough so gamers are not limited to lower resolutions on their monitor
- Records 4K HDR gameplay without reducing gaming settings
- Captures up to 240fps for competitive PC gaming content
- Flashback Recording lets streamers save moments they forgot to record

## Ideal For

- Hardcore PC gamers with high-end desktop rigs
- Dual-PC streamers who separate gaming and streaming workloads
- Content creators recording PS5 Pro or Xbox Series X at maximum quality
- Professionals archiving 4K HDR gameplay for post-production editing

## Example Use Cases

- Recording a PS5 Pro in 4K HDR while gaming at full 4K120 on an 8K display
- Running a dual-PC setup where the gaming PC outputs via HDMI to the streaming PC
- Capturing 240fps PC gameplay for slow-motion highlight clips
- Archiving footage in AAF format for Adobe Premiere or Vegas Pro editing

## Related Products

- Chat Link Pro (included free)
- Elgato Studio software
- Stream Deck (any model) for scene switching
- OBS Studio for advanced streaming
- Wave XLR or Wave:3 for live commentary

## Use Case

- Deliver the highest possible capture quality for PC-based streaming rigs
- Preserve the full gaming experience with 8K passthrough while recording at 4K
- Future-proof a streaming setup against next-gen display and console capabilities

## Problem

- USB capture cards bottleneck high-bandwidth 4K HDR signals
- Gaming PC performance impacted by encoding overhead in single-PC streaming
- Missing key moments because recording was not started in advance

## Recommended Setup

- Use Flashback Recording in Elgato Studio so no highlight is ever lost
- Export separate video and audio tracks as AAF files for multi-track editing in Adobe Premiere Pro
- In a dual-PC setup, connect the gaming PC HDMI output to the 4K Pro input and stream from the capture PC

## Why Elgato?

- Only Elgato capture card with HDMI 2.1 8K60 passthrough
- PCIe 2.0 x4 interface delivers maximum bandwidth compared to USB solutions
- On-device HDR-to-SDR tonemapping means HDR games can be captured cleanly without post-processing

# Network Dock - A networking accessory that frees Stream Deck from USB by adding Power over Ethernet (PoE) and wired Ethernet connectivity, allowing creators and professionals to deploy Stream Deck anywhere on a network without a nearby PC.

## Overview

Network Dock - A networking accessory that frees Stream Deck from USB by adding Power over Ethernet (PoE) and wired Ethernet connectivity, allowing creators and professionals to deploy Stream Deck anywhere on a network without a nearby PC.

## Key Features

- Ethernet connectivity via wired RJ45 for network-based Stream Deck control
- Power over Ethernet (PoE) support — no separate power adapter needed
- USB power fallback for non-PoE setups
- IP address configuration directly on Stream Deck display
- Compatible with Bitfocus Companion and Bitfocus Buttons
- Fits inside Stream Deck XL's stand for clean rack-mount use
- Bulk pricing with up to 10% discount for enterprise deployments

## Benefits

- Breaks the USB cable length limitation for Stream Deck placement
- Enables shared or dedicated Stream Deck controllers without a co-located PC
- Eliminates desktop cable clutter by hiding the PC while keeping Stream Deck accessible
- Allows rack-mounted Stream Deck deployment in broadcast and events environments

## Ideal For

- Broadcast producers and live event technical directors
- Studio operators who need remote Stream Deck placement
- Enterprise IT and AV system integrators
- Professional streamers with complex multi-room setups
- Venues and hospitality tech teams deploying shared controllers

## Example Use Cases

- Mounting a Stream Deck at a podium far from the production PC during a live event
- Installing a Stream Deck in a broadcast rack for remote triggering
- Deploying multiple Stream Decks across a building on the same network
- Placing Stream Deck on a camera operator's position without a nearby computer
- Powering and controlling Stream Deck over a PoE network switch in an AV install

## Related Products

- Stream Deck XL (fits inside the XL stand)
- Stream Deck MK.2 or Stream Deck Classic
- Bitfocus Companion software
- Stream Deck software app
- Master Mount for positioning

## Use Case

- Remove Stream Deck's USB tether to enable flexible placement across any space
- Enable PoE-powered deployment in professional broadcast and events environments
- Support enterprise-scale multi-device Stream Deck deployments

## Problem

- USB cable length limits where Stream Deck can be positioned relative to the PC
- Live event and broadcast setups need controllers far from production computers
- Managing multiple Stream Decks in a facility without network connectivity is impractical

## Recommended Setup

- Use a PoE-capable network switch to eliminate all power adapters from the Stream Deck position
- Fit Network Dock inside the Stream Deck XL stand for a clean, all-in-one mount
- Assign a static IP to each Stream Deck for reliable multi-device network management
- Combine with Bitfocus Companion for advanced show control trigger workflows

## Why Elgato?

- Only Elgato accessory that enables full Ethernet and PoE deployment of Stream Deck
- Unique fit inside Stream Deck XL stand for invisible installation
- Trusted by major live event production companies like Neumann & Müller at Red Bull events
